title: OneDrive for iPad: presentation mode for PDFs
summary: The roadmap and supplied Microsoft notice support the feature description, December rollout, enabled default and absence of a tenant switch. The checklist assumes an app-update delivery mechanism that Microsoft has not documented, and the licensing field should name OneDrive's published product-level entitlement rather than leave it wholly unknown.
